g.text: Tell me something if you would.
You and he are a Thing and I am very happy about that
You know him pretty well by now, after everything we've endured together, as a group
how do you cope when he does The Voice?
I feel like you MUST know what I mean, but I shall take your answer in good faith.
Wonderful. A clear case of naturally occurring immunity!
you're certainly not alone in that, from what I gather
I can't really take it seriously though. There are reasons.
Most of the time Arthur talks like a fairly normal human being, but there are times when he does The Voice.
We must ensure your body is donated to medical science.
... I just need you to know that to me, that will always be his Action Angus voice.
It's like listening to someone fix you a testosterone milkshake stirred up in a cement mixer.
"STAY CALM AND LET THE PROFESSIONALS HANDLE THIS" growls 8 year old Arthur as Action Angus and the plastic SAS are rescuing one of my Sandie dolls from the dinosaur army
It's so gravelly you could pick neolithic axe heads out of it.
For some reason it leaves otherwise sane and well adjusted people weak at the knees.
Hope I haven't ruined it for you!
Do you understand what I mean now?
